blurb: Guests cruise aboard the classic 42' Grand Banks yacht, the Rainbird, enjoying Seattle waterfront views including landmarks and wildlife. Cruises are private for groups up to 6 people, with a captain providing narration and navigation. The vessel is fully enclosed and equipped for comfort in any weather, with seating, a fly bridge deck, lounge, and bathrooms.

quotes.text: We booked this for a fun girlfriend cruise and Captain Kelley really delivered! Professional, funny and very knowledgeable about the Lake. You can sit upstairs with the captain or there’s a private area downstairs where we set up food and drinks. Heading home into the sunset was absolutely gorgeous. I would highly recommend this sunset cruise to anyone who just wants to have a good time in a beautiful space!

Phenomenal experience. Captain Kelly, true native, knows Seattle and its intriguing history and quirks. It was a wonderful evening on the water hearing stories of homes and venues that are water adjacent. Loved every minute. Everyone came away refreshed and with a knowledge of Seattle we would not have gotten any other way. A must do when you are in Seattle--even if you live there.

Absolutely fantastic! Captain Jerry and his crew were amazing. As nice as can be. Boat was big, clean, and well provisioned. Jerry knows the history and gossip about everything in and around Lakes Union and Washington. Our trip was fun and relaxing. Two enthusiastic thumbs up!

Had the most wonderful evening sailing with Jerry on sound view sunset cruises. Amazing boat, peaceful and beautiful informative caltain. Lots of fun and exactly what we hoped it would be Thank you Jerry cannot recommend you enough Jo and family ( 🇬🇧)

I went while my parents were visiting and we had a great time. Captain Kelley is knowledgeable and has fun/random facts of various sights along the tour. I would definitely recommend this to anyone that wants a tour of the waterways.

Was a great cruise! Was the highlight of our trip. So informative with such beautiful scenery. Captain Kelly pointed out all of the interesting spots & enlightened us as to what famous people lived where. Don’t forget your cameras!
